firewall.source: Renderer golden for schema/examples/four-cameras.yaml; tests/qemu/run.py adds the harness-only lan0 SSH rule.
firewall.reason: Rules loaded in the QEMU appliance guest on 2026-11-14. The rendered golden accepts 443 on lan0 for the Bittern UI (ADR 0019); 8971 is the loopback-only Frigate UI, not a LAN service. 8971 answered on the loopback login page inside the guest; 5000, 1984, 8554, and 8555 produced no answer from lan0, and there is no host forward for 8971. The loaded table matched the renderer golden except for the harness SSH rule. nft -c -f accepts the golden with nftables 1.1.3 in the guest. The development container still cannot initialize netlink, so the check runs in the guest.

sbom.source: Generate from the pinned OCI image and its layers at bundle-build time, for example with Syft or registry SBOM support, and attach it to the signed bundle. Do not hand-write an SBOM.
